findings.description: The loop no longer removes names listed in param.secondary_opts from the help option names, unlike the removed code that did. A secondary option that matches a configured help name is now offered as a help name too.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command sets help_option_names to include "-h" and has a boolean flag declared as "--verbose/-h", so "-h" is in that flag's secondary_opts. The old code subtracted secondary_opts, so "-h" was dropped from the help names. The new loop only pops param.opts, so "-h" stays as a help name and collides with the flag's secondary option. Impact: the same token both toggles the flag and triggers help, so the parser's behavior for it is ambiguous or changes from before the commit.
